summary: Verified current US retail prices (Aug 13, 2026) for 7 golf launch monitors spanning the three budget bands, each with confirmed simulator-software compatibility and subscription costs. Value tier ($500-700): Garmin R10 ($499.99), Rapsodo MLM2PRO ($599.99), Voice Caddie SC4 Pro ($599.99, newcomer). Core/mid tier ($2000-3500): SkyTrak+ has been discontinued and replaced by SkyTrak ST MAX ($1,995 sale/$2,995 list), FlightScope Mevo+ is discontinued and replaced by Mevo Gen2 ($1,299 base), Uneekor EYE MINI Lite ($1,999 sale/$2,750 list). Premium tier ($3500-7000): Bushnell Launch Pro Circle B Edition ($2,999.99, below the $3500 floor but the standard premium camera-based option) plus GSPro/E6 Connect/Awesome Golf third-party software costs which recur across multiple monitors. Every monitor except FlightScope Mevo Gen2 and Voice Caddie SC4 Pro requires a paid annual subscription tier for full simulator/course access; the cheapest monitors (Garmin, Rapsodo, Voice Caddie) still need $199-300/yr in add-on software (E6 Connect, Awesome Golf, or GSPro) for a true simulator experience.

findings.software_compat: Bundled: Garmin Golf app (basic free tier). Compatible add-on sim software: E6 Connect (TruGolf, sold separately), Awesome Golf (sold separately), TGC 2019 (sold separately). NOT compatible with GSPro.
findings.subscription_notes: MSRP $599.99, currently on sale $499.99 (also seen $499-549 elsewhere, confirms sale is broad). Garmin Golf app Premium content is $9.99/mo or $99/yr (30-day free trial) for green contours etc. To get a real simulator experience you must also buy E6 Connect ($300-600/yr or one-time engine license) or Awesome Golf ($159.99/yr or $14.99/mo). No GSPro support.

findings.software_compat: Bundled Rapsodo app. Compatible with GSPro, E6 Connect/E6 Apex, and Awesome Golf for course play.
findings.subscription_notes: Regular price $699.99, currently discounted to $599.99. Includes 45-day free trial of Premium Membership. After trial, Premium Membership required for full simulator courses (30,000+ virtual courses), cloud storage, spin metrics, and video analysis: $199.99/yr, or 2-yr $329.99, or lifetime $599.99. Spin data requires RPT-branded balls (Titleist Pro V1 or Callaway Chrome Tour).

findings.software_compat: Bundled E6 Connect (5 golf courses + 1 driving range included free, iOS/PC). Also free companion VoiceCaddie S app for practice tracking. No confirmed GSPro or Awesome Golf support.
findings.subscription_notes: 2025-2026 newcomer. No required subscription — E6 Connect starter course pack included at no extra cost, described by vendor/reviewers as running 'without subscription fees.' Some retailers/coupons bring price to $499-549.

findings.product: SkyTrak+ (discontinued, replaced by SkyTrak ST MAX)
findings.software_compat: Proprietary SkyTrak software (Shot History, Shot Optimizer, Practice Randomizer). Membership tiers add WGT by Topgolf and E6 Connect course packs. Not GSPro-native (SkyTrak uses its own ecosystem, though some players interface it with GSPro via third-party connector).
findings.subscription_notes: IMPORTANT: SkyTrak+ itself is discontinued/being phased out; SkyTrak ST MAX (same $2,995 list, currently $1,995 on sale, i.e. $1,000 off) is the direct successor as of late 2025. A certified pre-owned original SkyTrak (older/base model, not the '+') was separately seen for $695 promo — do not confuse with ST MAX. Membership plans (2026 restructure): Core (FS) $199.99/yr, Elite $399.99/yr; older 'Play and Improve' plan was $249.95/yr before consolidation.

findings.product: FlightScope Mevo+ (discontinued, replaced by Mevo Gen2)
findings.software_compat: Bundled FS Golf Practice App and FS Skills Challenges App. Compatible with E6 Connect, Awesome Golf, and GSPro (PC).
findings.subscription_notes: Mevo+ is discontinued and no longer sold by FlightScope directly (some 3rd-party stock existed at deep discount ~$1,099 down from $2,299 list, unverified as current). Its replacement, Mevo Gen2, is $1,299 base and includes an 8-course E6 Connect bundle with LIFETIME ownership (no recurring fee for those courses). Additional E6 Connect 12-course pack upgrade is a one-time $250. Vendor states no required subscriptions/hidden fees for core functionality. Pro Package and Face Impact Location are optional one-time add-ons (bundle with both: $2,274 sale / $2,798 list).

findings.software_compat: Uneekor VIEW software platform: Refine/Refine+ course play (Pro package+), AI Trainer (Champion package, needs extra Swing Optix cameras), GameDay (Ultimate package). Free Player Package included with every unit for basic ball/club data with no fees.
findings.subscription_notes: List price $2,750, currently discounted to $1,999 (confirmed matching on both official uneekor.com and authorized dealer shopindoorgolf.com). Full simulator/course play requires paid tier: Pro Package $199/yr, Champion Package $399/yr, Ultimate Package $599/yr. New units include complimentary 3-month trial of Ultimate Package.

findings.software_compat: FSX Play/FSX Pro (Foresight's own simulator software, via Silver/Gold tiers). GSPro compatible but sold as a separate paid add-on requiring active Gold subscription. No native E6 Connect/Awesome Golf mentioned.
findings.subscription_notes: Circle B Edition (current standard SKU, orange/black) is $2,999.99 (metal-case upgrade variant $3,129.99). Note: some retailers briefly listed a promotional Circle B price of $2,499 — playbetter's own live product page now shows $2,999.99, so treat $2,499 as a lapsed/regional promo, not current price. Silver subscription $199.99/yr (ball & club data, 5 courses, Pinseeker, FSX Pro). Gold subscription $499/yr (ball & club data, 25 courses, full FSX Play simulation). GSPro access is a further $250/yr add-on requiring active Gold. 14-day free trial of Gold included with new purchase. This monitor sits below the stated $3,500-7,000 premium band on hardware price alone, but total year-1 cost (device + Gold + GSPro) reaches ~$3,750, effectively landing it in the premium band once software is included.

findings.product: GSPro (third-party simulator software, used by Rapsodo, Mevo Gen2, Bushnell add-on)
findings.software_compat: Compatible launch monitors: Rapsodo MLM2PRO, FlightScope Mevo Gen2, Bushnell Launch Pro (via Gold sub), Uneekor line. NOT compatible with Garmin R10.
findings.subscription_notes: $250/year annual license, no perpetual/one-time option. Includes free access to a ~2,000-course community library while subscription is active; access lost if it lapses. Relevant as a shared software-budget line item since several monitors route through GSPro rather than a bundled proprietary app.

findings.product: E6 Connect / E6 by TruGolf (third-party simulator software, used by Garmin, Rapsodo, Mevo Gen2, Voice Caddie)
findings.software_compat: Compatible with Garmin R10, Rapsodo MLM2PRO, FlightScope Mevo Gen2 (bundle included), Voice Caddie SC4 Pro (bundle included).
findings.subscription_notes: E6 Connect (legacy, business/multi-bay oriented): Basic $300/yr, Expanded $600/yr. Newer E6 by TruGolf (2026, consumer-oriented): Play tier $300/yr, Improve tier $150/yr add-on. Engine can be purchased once with no subscription, but content/course access is then limited to whatever ships with the engine.

findings.product: Awesome Golf (third-party simulator software, used by Garmin, Rapsodo, Mevo Gen2)
findings.software_compat: Compatible with Garmin R10, Rapsodo MLM2PRO, FlightScope Mevo Gen2. License is tied to the launch monitor, not the OS device, so it travels across Windows/Mac/ChromeOS/iOS/Android on the same monitor.
findings.subscription_notes: Annual plan $159.99/yr; monthly $14.99/mo; lifetime license $349.99 one-time. 14-day free trial for new users, no commitment required to start trial.
